entities.summary: Ribal al-Assad is a Syrian businessman and political activist. He is the founder and director of the Organisation for Freedom and Democracy in Syria|Organisation for Democracy and Freedom in Syria (ODFS) and the chairman and founder of the Iman Foundation.
